Reset This World and Prestige/New Game+ now use the site's shared confirmation dialog instead of a plain browser popup.
The welcome-back toast now shows a real "+X worlds, +Y achievements since you were last here" delta for this browser, instead of just restating your current totals.

Colorblind-safety audit completed — no hue-only state encodings found, no change needed.
